lines.text: A bug you spotted at midnight.
A key only you can rotate.
A task Claude promised to get to... eventually.
And halfway through a session, they scatter.
Meet Sticky Board: a tiny pane that lives right inside Claude Code.
Up top, the phase you're in.
Below it, three short lists. What Claude still has to do. What only you can do. And the bugs you know about.
Claude keeps it current on its own. It files new work, ticks off what's finished,
and gives you a nudge when something lands on your list.
You just glance, and click to tick it off.
One board per project, all in one plain file.
Sticky Board. Keep your loose ends where you can see them.
